Saudia Flight Pass Terms and Conditions
html:
Saudia Flight Pass Terms and Conditions

Flight Pass

Flight Pass Terms & Conditions

Flight Pass is a subscription plan that allows you to travel to a wide range of remarkable destinations at a fixed competitive rate on Saudia’s flights.

Contract Duration 12 Months
Advance Booking Min. 3 Days
Eligible Age 18+ Years
Fare Brand Guest Basic
  • The service is available for purchase as a 12-month contract with a fixed amount which can be paid using different methods of collection. Moreover, it is automatically renewed after one year with an option for cancellation available one month prior to the end of the subscription renewal date.
  • “Saudia” reserves the right to change the subscription prices, benefits, or its conditions upon renewal, provided that the subscriber is notified of such changes one month prior to the renewal of the subscription.
  • You can always select the plan that is most suitable for your needs and subscribe to the service through the (Flight Pass website).
  • You can opt out and terminate the subscription within the first 7 days provided that no ticket has been issued.
  • The service is available for guests who are 18 years old or above.
  • All subscriptions are individual, and the quota and/or tickets cannot be transferred or exchanged to another person.
  • It is permitted to include beneficiaries after subscribing to the service.
  • Beneficiaries can be Adult, Child, infant, or infant occupying a seat.
  • Beneficiaries are not limited to family members, and they cannot be replaced until the end of the subscription.
  • The number of permitted beneficiaries depends on the subscription plan.
  • Beneficiaries will be consuming from the main subscriber’s credits and will be charged the same fees and taxes. (excluding Infants which will be charged specific fare).
  • Important: The main subscriber must be included in every booking, and beneficiaries cannot travel independently.

The subscription charges will be collected using one of the following methods:

  • Per-cycle: (every three months) on the first day of the month.
  • Annual: Payment of the total charge as a one-time annual payment.

The charges are collected through (Saudia Partner) using the approved credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, and AMEX).

  • The subscription charges include VAT.
  • The charges are collected through an international point of sales, and charges might be applied by the bank.
  • The flight quota will subsequently be updated to be redeemed on eligible flights following successful payment.
  • If the payment is not processed for any reason, the whole subscription will be automatically placed on hold as inactive until the card details are updated.
  • The quota is refreshed every cycle for the “quarterly payment plan”, and any unredeemed quota will automatically expire in the next cycle, while the full quota for the “one-time payment plan” is unlocked immediately. And the quota will expire at the end of the subscription date.
  • Any subscription that occurs on any day of the month will be considered a full month during that cycle.
  • Upon facing any issues in payment, please contact (Sales Support).
  • The subscription charges do not include airport fees and taxes, Carrier Imposed Surcharges and will be collected upon redemption.
  • The fare is designed to align with Saudia’s branded fares (Basic Brand) following the same conditions in seat selection, and baggage allowance.
  • Ticket redemption can only be processed through the (Flight Pass website), using any Saudia approved cards.
  • The flight must be booked at least three days prior to departure date using the available balance.
  • Currently, in the subscription, flights must be on a round-trip basis for all domestic routes except the following airports/cities:
    • (from/to Dawadmi), (from/to Rafha), (from/to Neom), and (from/to Red Sea).

Flight changes can be processed digitally from the website and SAUDIA’s point of sales. Flight changes are permitted with fees, while a higher fee will be imposed in the event of a no-show.

Flight Change and Cancellation Fees
Transaction Type Applicable Fee
Voluntary Rebooking SAR 250 + VAT
Voluntary Cancellation & Refund SAR 300 + VAT (The ticket quota will be refunded to the subscription balance)
No-Show Fee SAR 400 + VAT
Failing to Board Fee SAR 550 + VAT

Voluntary cancellations can be requested through “Saudia” website, Guest Care Centers or Sales Offices. Upon cancellation, the ticket quota will be refunded to the subscription balance.

  • “SAUDIA” reserves the right to deny any passenger for safety reasons. Guests who do not comply with approved safety instructions will lose their eligibility for the refund.
  • In the event of any misuse (including any use that breaches these terms and conditions, such as, violations of rights, usage of fake identities, or fraud), and/or discontinuity of the Flight Pass Program at any time, “SAUDIA” reserves the right to cancel subscriptions at its sole discretion at any time. Communication with affected customers will be shared in advance.
  • In case of circumstances beyond SAUDIA’s control or any unforeseen flight disruptions, “SAUDIA” will take all necessary measures to accommodate all guest requests. Nevertheless, requests for involuntary changes or refunds will be allowed in case of flight delays or cancellations according to Saudia’s policies.

By submitting this request and paying for the service, I agree to all SAUDIA’s terms and conditions in addition to the general rules of carriage.
